skillDispatch.when: Auditing, applying, or refreshing the Context-Driven Baseline.
Starting creative feature or behavior design before implementation.
Expanding a product-level idea into a researched opportunity artifact.
Defining product requirements and user outcomes.
Settling implementation architecture and technical contracts.
Decomposing an approved Spec into a dependency-ordered Task Graph.
Executing exactly one assigned Spec Task.
Executing every pending Task in a Spec Task Graph.
Running final Spec QA after implementation Tasks complete.
Archiving a completed and QA-passed Spec.
Writing CONTEXT-driven guides, Specs, ADRs, findings, or handoffs.

rules.guidance: Read the repository's selected domain context and relevant accepted ADRs before naming domain concepts or changing behavior. Flag conflicts instead of silently overriding repository decisions.

Give each documentation directory one job: `docs/_inbox/` for raw notes, `docs/adr/` for decisions, `docs/agents/` for agent guidance, `docs/design/` for design artifacts, `docs/findings/` for dated investigations, `docs/handoffs/` for session continuity, `docs/references/` for external pointers, and `docs/user-guide/` for human documentation. Findings use `status: pending | partial | deferred | done` with created and updated dates. Set `status: done` as soon as the Spec is created and linked; the Spec owns implementation, QA, archive, and release progress. Preserve repository-authored extensions outside setup markers.
